decision.explanation: The item was delivered 2 days ago, which is within the 10-day return window for home category items. The item arrived broken, so it qualifies as damaged. A return pickup is scheduled per policy E3 and E5, since the item value (₹399) is above ₹500, no immediate refund is issued. No photo evidence is required as the item value is under ₹2000 per E6. The user will get a full refund including shipping after pickup completion. User consent for return pickup scheduling is needed before proceeding.
